title: Datafold Failures by Table
app: Datafold data-diff and monitor results via the Datafold API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=datafold:diff status="failed" OR alert="true"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by table_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Datafold failures grouped by table so operators immediately see which specific tables are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Datafold is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Datafold failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical tables.
visualization: Table of table by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Datafold are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
